focus: 以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型~Interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains

units.anchor: 弗勞德縮尺條件~Froude scaling conditions
units.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件~Froude scaling conditions
units.mechanism: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。黏滯、表面張力和含氣衝擊卻不能同時自動相似，縮小到細小水舌時必須重新檢查主導機制，避免只憑幾何比例接受模型。 假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。 空氣可壓縮性與液滴破裂對縮尺的反應不同，須分開選擇可外推的觀察量。~Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity, surface tension and aerated impacts do not automatically remain similar; a thin model water tongue may therefore change the dominant physics despite geometrically accurate construction. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Air compressibility and droplet breakup respond differently to scaling, requiring separate decisions about which observations can be extrapolated.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only.
units.verify: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。比較不同縮尺的關鍵輸出，記錄哪種現象不能由單一重力相似支持外推。另列模型最小水深與最大流速。~Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed. Compare critical outputs at different scales and record phenomena for which gravity similarity alone cannot justify extrapolation. Also tabulate minimum model depth and maximum flow speed.
units.failure: 若模型小到表面張力控制薄層水流，堤頂濺水與集水比例便可能偏離原型；幾何尺寸全部合格仍無法消除這種尺度效應，放大結果也不會自動恢復真實物理。~If surface tension dominates thin model flow, crest splashing and collected fractions differ from the prototype. Accurate geometry cannot eliminate that scale effect, and multiplying the result does not restore the missing physics.
units.misconception: 長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。~Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
units.practice: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。比較不同縮尺的關鍵輸出，記錄哪種現象不能由單一重力相似支持外推。~Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed. Compare critical outputs at different scales and record phenomena for which gravity similarity alone cannot justify extrapolation.

units.title: 單寬流量換算~Unit-discharge conversion
units.mechanism: 單寬越波流量的量綱是面積除時間，與整條海堤的總流量不同。重力相似下它按長度比的二分之三次方縮放，先辨清是否已除試驗寬度，才能避免額外乘一次長度比例造成嚴重誤差。 假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。 若沿堤方向越波不均，單一收集段也不能代表整條堤線的流量分布。~Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall. Under gravity similarity it scales with length to the three-halves power. Determine whether the measured quantity has already been divided by width before applying a second width conversion. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance. Spatially uneven overtopping means one collector segment cannot represent the discharge distribution along the entire seawall.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance.
units.verify: 把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。再由另一人從基本量綱重建換算，確認圖表與資料檔的單位一致。再由單寬量反算收集段總量。~Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately. Have another reviewer reconstruct the conversion from dimensions and check that plots and exported tables use identical units. Reconstruct total collected-section flow from the unit-width result.
units.failure: 若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。圖表數值看似合理時，單位錯誤仍可一路傳入排水需求。~Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading. Plausible-looking plots may carry the unit error directly into drainage estimates unless the original dimensions remain visible.
units.misconception: 單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。~Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
units.practice: 把原始集水體積、試驗寬度與有效時間保存在同一紀錄中，分別計算總流量和單寬流量。再由另一人從基本量綱重建換算，確認圖表與資料檔的單位一致。~Keep collected volume, test width and valid duration together, calculating total and unit-width discharge separately. Have another reviewer reconstruct the conversion from dimensions and check that plots and exported tables use identical units.

units.anchor: 集水控制體積~Collection control volume
units.title: 集水控制體積~Collection control volume
units.mechanism: 集水裝置量到的是進入特定容器的水，不一定等於全部跨越堤頂的水。側漏、濺出、槽內滯留與試驗結束後延遲排水都會破壞收支；控制體積及起訖時刻應先定義，再討論平均越波量。 假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。 計量解析度在低越波情境尤其重要，小讀值可能與容器零點漂移相當。~A collection device measures water entering a particular container, not necessarily everything crossing the crest. Side leakage, splash loss, storage and delayed drainage disrupt the balance. Define the control volume and start/end times before interpreting the measurement as mean overtopping discharge. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance. Meter resolution becomes especially important at low overtopping, where the collected increment may resemble tank zero drift.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance.
units.verify: 用已知水量做集水校準，記錄容器讀值、側漏與殘留，並分開波列有效段和後續排空時間。以另一種流量或重量量測交叉檢查，保留零越波與低於檢出限的區別。用空白試驗量化容器零點漂移。~Calibrate with known water input, recording tank reading, leakage and retention while separating the valid wave sequence from later drainage. Cross-check by weight or independent flow measurement and distinguish zero overtopping from values below detection limits. Quantify collector zero drift through a blank test.
units.failure: 狹窄收集槽可能漏掉斜向越波，餘水又可能被算到下一組試驗；這兩種偏差可互相抵銷，使平均值看似穩定，卻無法支持不同斷面的可靠比較。~A narrow collector can miss oblique discharge while retained water enters the next test. Opposing biases may cancel in the mean, producing apparently stable results that do not support reliable comparison between sections.
units.misconception: 收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。~A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
units.practice: 用已知水量做集水校準，記錄容器讀值、側漏與殘留，並分開波列有效段和後續排空時間。以另一種流量或重量量測交叉檢查，保留零越波與低於檢出限的區別。~Calibrate with known water input, recording tank reading, leakage and retention while separating the valid wave sequence from later drainage. Cross-check by weight or independent flow measurement and distinguish zero overtopping from values below detection limits.

units.title: 不規則波能量~Irregular-wave energy
units.mechanism: 不規則波需由波面紀錄建立能譜及統計量，單一最大波不能取代整段波列的代表波高。頻帶截取、漂移去除和量測位置會改變零階譜矩，需記清處理方法，才能把造波設定與入射波條件對上。 假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。 譜矩是波面變異的積分描述，頻率單位與積分間距必須在程式中一致。~Irregular waves require a surface-elevation record, spectrum and statistical description. One maximum wave cannot replace a representative height for the sequence. Frequency limits, detrending and measurement location alter the zero-order spectral moment, so processing must remain traceable when comparing generator settings with incident conditions. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1. The moment integrates surface-elevation variance, requiring consistent frequency units and integration spacing throughout the processing code.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1.
units.verify: 保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。用時域波高分布交叉比較譜波高，並列出兩者定義差異而非強迫相等。獨立檢查頻率積分與波面變異數。~Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently. Compare spectral height with the time-domain wave-height distribution, documenting their differing definitions instead of forcing numerical agreement. Independently compare spectral integration with surface-elevation variance.
units.failure: 感測器慢漂移若被當成低頻波能，譜矩會被抬高；另一方面過度濾波可能刪掉真實長週期能量。相同造波設定不能保證處理後的有效波況相同。~Slow sensor drift mistaken for wave energy inflates the spectral moment, while aggressive filtering removes genuine long-period energy. Identical generator settings therefore do not guarantee equivalent effective wave conditions after processing.
units.misconception: 最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。~Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height.
units.practice: 保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。用時域波高分布交叉比較譜波高，並列出兩者定義差異而非強迫相等。~Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently. Compare spectral height with the time-domain wave-height distribution, documenting their differing definitions instead of forcing numerical agreement.

units.anchor: 相對出水高度~Relative crest freeboard
units.title: 相對出水高度~Relative crest freeboard
units.mechanism: 越波對堤頂相對水面的高度十分敏感，潮位、增水及基準偏差都會改變有效出水高。比較試驗時必須區分堤頂變化和靜水面變化，兩者在幾何上可能等效，但對前灘水深與破波位置的影響不同。 假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。 有效出水高的分母應使用結構前指定位置的入射波，而非任意遠端設定值。~Overtopping responds strongly to crest level relative to still water. Tide, surge and datum bias alter effective freeboard. Crest adjustment and water-level change can produce the same nominal freeboard while changing foreshore depth and breaking location differently, so the complete geometry must be retained. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40. Relative freeboard should use incident waves at the specified structure location rather than an arbitrary distant generator setting.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40.
units.verify: 從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。重做水位改變時需重新校準結構前的入射波，檢查是否同時改變破波型態。列出水位修正前後的前灘水深。~Measure crest and still water from one datum and include level uncertainty alongside wave conditions in the test matrix. Recalibrate incident waves before the structure after changing water level, checking for a simultaneous change in breaking regime. List foreshore depths before and after each level correction.
units.failure: 模型底板沉陷或水位零點偏移會讓標稱出水高失真，越波量變化可能因此被誤認為新堤型較好；只校核堤頂尺寸而忽略水面基準無法辨識原因。~Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard. The resulting discharge change may be mistaken for an improved wall geometry, and checking crest dimensions alone will not reveal the cause.
units.misconception: 相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。~Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping.
units.practice: 從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。重做水位改變時需重新校準結構前的入射波，檢查是否同時改變破波型態。~Measure crest and still water from one datum and include level uncertainty alongside wave conditions in the test matrix. Recalibrate incident waves before the structure after changing water level, checking for a simultaneous change in breaking regime.

units.anchor: 入射反射分離~Incident-reflected wave separation
units.title: 入射反射分離~Incident-reflected wave separation
units.mechanism: 結構反射與入射波疊加形成空間起伏，單點量測可能剛好位在節點或腹點。要把試驗與設計入射波連結，需用適當測點配置和分離方法；反射振幅比也不能直接當成反射能量比。 假設分離得到入射振幅0.50m、反射0.20m，Kr=0.40；同介質同頻率下反射能量比約Kr²=0.16。 能量比例的平方關係還假設入射和反射有相同的傳播介質與群速。~Reflected and incident waves create spatial interference, so a single gauge may sit near a node or antinode. Appropriate gauge geometry and separation are needed to recover incident conditions. An amplitude reflection coefficient also differs from the associated energy fraction under matched propagation conditions. Assume separated incident and reflected amplitudes0.50m and0.20m. Kr=0.40; for matched medium and frequency the reflected energy fraction is approximately0.16. Squaring amplitudes for energy additionally assumes matched propagation medium and group velocity for incident and reflected components.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設分離得到入射振幅0.50m、反射0.20m，Kr=0.40；同介質同頻率下反射能量比約Kr²=0.16。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume separated incident and reflected amplitudes0.50m and0.20m. Kr=0.40; for matched medium and frequency the reflected energy fraction is approximately0.16.
units.verify: 先在無結構或已知反射條件下驗證分離方法，檢查測點距離相對波長是否合適。用多組距離重算結果並記錄無法可靠分離的頻帶，避免只報一個漂亮係數。對分離後波列重建原始量測訊號。~Verify separation against absent or known reflection, checking gauge spacing against wavelength. Recompute using alternative gauge combinations and identify frequency bands with unreliable separation rather than reporting only one attractive overall coefficient. Reconstruct measured signals from the separated wave components.
units.failure: 測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。~Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection. Normalizing discharge with the resulting wrong incident height compounds the error across two analysis stages, even when both outputs appear smoothly varying.
units.misconception: 反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。~Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
units.practice: 先在無結構或已知反射條件下驗證分離方法，檢查測點距離相對波長是否合適。用多組距離重算結果並記錄無法可靠分離的頻帶，避免只報一個漂亮係數。~Verify separation against absent or known reflection, checking gauge spacing against wavelength. Recompute using alternative gauge combinations and identify frequency bands with unreliable separation rather than reporting only one attractive overall coefficient.

units.anchor: 取樣頻帶配置~Sampling bandwidth selection
units.title: 取樣頻帶配置~Sampling bandwidth selection
units.mechanism: 波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。取樣前的類比濾波與感測器自身頻率響應同樣重要，事後加密插值只能增加點數，無法回復已混疊或漏掉的訊號。 假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。 感測器的固有頻率和裝置共振同樣限制有效頻帶，不能僅查擷取器規格。~Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales. Sampling sufficient for the main wave period may miss brief pressure peaks. Analog filtering and sensor response matter before digitization; interpolating afterward increases sample count without recovering aliased or absent information. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks. Sensor natural frequency and rig resonance also limit useful bandwidth, so acquisition specifications alone are insufficient evidence.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks.
units.verify: 分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。以已知快變訊號檢查峰值與相位，保留抗混疊設定及原始時間戳供重算。比較不同取樣率所得峰值收斂性。~Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain. Use a known rapidly changing signal to assess peak and phase response, retaining anti-alias settings and raw timestamps for reconstruction. Compare peak convergence at several justified sampling rates.
units.failure: 過低頻率會漏掉短峰，過高頻率若未控制電噪音又可能產生假峰。平滑後的波形不等於可信波形，將其當結構設計荷載前仍須確認頻率響應。~Low sampling misses short peaks, while uncontrolled electrical noise at high rates creates false ones. A smooth trace is not automatically credible, and structural load interpretation still requires demonstrated frequency response of the measurement chain.
units.misconception: 每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。~Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak.
units.practice: 分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。以已知快變訊號檢查峰值與相位，保留抗混疊設定及原始時間戳供重算。~Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain. Use a known rapidly changing signal to assess peak and phase response, retaining anti-alias settings and raw timestamps for reconstruction.

units.title: 堤頂水舌流態~Crest-flow regime
units.mechanism: 跨堤水舌具有局部水深與速度，平均單寬流量無法唯一決定兩者。弗勞德數可比較慣性與重力尺度，但不含人員失衡、漂浮物及脈動衝擊；同一平均越波量仍可能對應很不同的瞬間流況。 假設局部v=2m/s、h=0.30m，Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17；這是局部流態指標，不是通行安全判定。 水舌前緣可能近似乾濕交界，局部水深接近零時此比值會很敏感。~A crest water tongue has local depth and velocity that mean unit discharge cannot uniquely determine. The Froude number compares inertia with gravity but excludes pedestrian instability, debris and impulsive loading. Equal mean overtopping can therefore conceal very different instantaneous flow regimes at the crest. Assume local v=2m/s and h=0.30m. Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17 is a local flow-regime indicator, not an access-safety decision. The tongue front approaches a wet-dry boundary, making the ratio highly sensitive when local depth approaches zero.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設局部v=2m/s、h=0.30m，Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17；這是局部流態指標，不是通行安全判定。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume local v=2m/s and h=0.30m. Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17 is a local flow-regime indicator, not an access-safety decision.
units.verify: 同步量測水深與速度而非分別取各自最大值，檢查儀器在含氣薄層中的有效性。用影像核對水舌範圍及持續時間，並把局部資料和整段平均流量分開呈現。記錄深度感測器失效與含氣片段。~Measure depth and velocity simultaneously instead of combining unrelated maxima, checking sensor validity in shallow aerated flow. Use video to confirm tongue extent and duration, presenting local measurements separately from whole-sequence mean discharge. Flag depth-sensor dropout and strongly aerated intervals explicitly.
units.failure: 水深與速度不同步會產生根本未發生的極端組合，含氣又可能讓讀值失真。只報單一弗勞德數會掩蓋持續時間與空間分布，無法支撐通行或構造安全宣稱。~Unsynchronized depth and velocity create extreme combinations that never occurred, while air distorts measurements. One Froude value hides duration and spatial distribution and cannot establish public access or structural safety by itself.
units.misconception: 弗勞德數小於某一數字就能直接開放海堤通行。~A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access.
units.practice: 同步量測水深與速度而非分別取各自最大值，檢查儀器在含氣薄層中的有效性。用影像核對水舌範圍及持續時間，並把局部資料和整段平均流量分開呈現。~Measure depth and velocity simultaneously instead of combining unrelated maxima, checking sensor validity in shallow aerated flow. Use video to confirm tongue extent and duration, presenting local measurements separately from whole-sequence mean discharge.

units.title: 重複試驗變異~Repeated-test variability
units.mechanism: 相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。重複試驗應涵蓋波列變異，而不只是重讀同一段資料；平均值的不確定度也不等於單次事件分散程度。 假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。 獨立性涉及實際波列而非檔案數量，系統校準偏差也不會隨重複次數消失。~The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima. Repeats should sample sequence variability rather than reread identical data. Uncertainty of the mean differs from the spread of individual events or test outcomes. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented. Independence concerns the physical realization rather than file count, and shared calibration bias does not vanish through repetition.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented.
units.verify: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。分開列出隨機變異與共同校準誤差。~Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty. Separate random variability from shared calibration uncertainty explicitly.
units.failure: 重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。~Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. Removing a high-discharge realization further distorts the tail behavior that matters for the engineering interpretation of unusually severe events.
units.misconception: 重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。~Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples.
units.practice: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。~Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty.

units.anchor: 局部荷載與平均量~Local load versus mean flow
units.title: 局部荷載與平均量~Local load versus mean flow
units.mechanism: 越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。力、壓力和受力面積必須區分，壓力感測器的空間平均也會抹去小範圍峰值；不能由流量合格推論所有附屬構件合格。 假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。 峰值持續時間決定荷載衝量，結構反應也受自身頻率與阻尼控制。~Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact. Distinguish force, pressure and loaded area; spatial averaging by a pressure sensor also smooths small peaks. Passing a discharge criterion does not qualify every secondary component. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak. Peak duration controls load impulse, while the structural response additionally depends on its natural frequencies and damping.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak.
units.verify: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。另外積分時間歷程取得荷載衝量。~Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions. Integrate the force history separately to obtain impulse.
units.failure: 小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。若只存最大數字而不存時間歷程，便無法分辨水力作用與儀器反應。~Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks. Retaining only a maximum value prevents separation of the hydraulic event from the instrument response that followed it.
units.misconception: 平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。~Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels.
units.practice: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。~Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions.

title: 海堤越波模型試驗~Overtopping model tests for seawalls
summary: 以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。~Interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
history: 本課的知識脈絡採用可核對的工程文獻，而不替工法編造單一發明年份。美國工兵團官方目錄列出二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊分冊；越波研究團隊於二〇〇七年發布首版手冊，二〇一八年第二版擴展結構型式、試驗與結果解釋。香港海港手冊持續列出勘誤，提醒設計引用必須指定版本。紐比金灣與博斯是海岸防護和監測的比較案例，不表示兩地採用了本課每項構件或假設尺寸。歷史資料用於理解方法演進，合成數據則另作學徒推理練習。~The knowledge history follows verifiable publications rather than inventing a single date when the technique was created. USACE lists its Coastal Engineering Manual parts in2002. The overtopping authors issued the first manual in2007 and expanded structural types, testing and interpretation in the2018 edition. Hong Kong continues to list corrigenda, demonstrating why an applied design must identify its reference version. Newbiggin Bay and Borth are comparisons of coastal protection and monitoring, not claims that both used every component or assumed dimension in this course. Publication history explains methodological development; synthetic values separately support the apprentice exercises.
example: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。假設長度比由25增10%為27.5，固定原型週期10s時模型週期由2降為1.9069s，下降約4.65%；不能把時間也直接縮小10%。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。~This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Increasing length ratio from25 to27.5 by10% at fixed prototype period10s changes model period from2 to1.9069s, about4.65% lower; time does not change by10%. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設分離得到入射振幅0.50m、反射0.20m，Kr=0.40；同介質同頻率下反射能量比約Kr²=0.16。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume separated incident and reflected amplitudes0.50m and0.20m. Kr=0.40; for matched medium and frequency the reflected energy fraction is approximately0.16.
